jp: おかげで助かっている。再び貴君の助力が必要となった時は、また連絡するのでよろしく頼む。
jp_grezzo: "おかげで助かっている。再び貴君の助力が必要となった時は、また連絡するのでよろしく頼む。"
en: You've been a great help. If I ever need your assistance again, I'll contact you.
en_grezzo: "You've been a great help. If I ever need your assistance again, I'll contact you."
it: Grazie a te siamo a posto. Se dovessi aver bisogno ancora del tuo aiuto ti farò sapere: conto su di te.

jp: 貴君に感謝する。検査の結果、数機が電子ウイルスに感染して狂っていたことが判明。他の者も電子頭脳が熱暴走しており、いつ爆発してもおかしくない状態であった。これは私からの礼だ。受け取ってくれ。
jp_grezzo: "貴君に感謝する。検査の結果、数機が電子ウイルスに感染して狂っていたことが判明。他の者も電子頭脳が熱暴走しており、いつ爆発してもおかしくない状態であった。これは私からの礼だ。受け取ってくれ。"
en: I thank you. The tests revealed that several of the machines had been infected by an electronic virus and were going crazy. Others were suffering from overheating that originated in their electronic brains, and they could have exploded at any moment. This is my way of thanking you. Please accept it.
en_grezzo: "I thank you. The tests revealed that several of the machines had been infected by an electronic virus and were going crazy. Others were suffering from overheating that originated in their electronic brains, and they could have exploded at any moment. This is my way of thanking you. Please accept it."
it: Ti sono grato. Dal controllo è risultato che alcune macchine erano impazzite per un virus elettronico. Anche le altre avevano il cervello elettronico surriscaldato fuori controllo: potevano esplodere da un momento all'altro. Questo è il mio ringraziamento. Accettalo.

jp: もうこりごりだよ～
jp_grezzo: "もうこりごりだよ～"
en: I'm sick of this.
en_grezzo: "I'm sick of this."
it: Ne ho avuto abbastanza...

jp: 次の区画はもっとうまくやれるでしょう
jp_grezzo: "次の区画はもっとうまくやれるでしょう"
en: I'll do even better this time.
en_grezzo: "I'll do even better this time."
it: Nel prossimo settore farò meglio

jp: ログを見るに、他の区画でも暴走している作業機械がいるようなのだが…潜入して彼らにも精密検査を受けさせてくれないだろうか？各区画は独立していて、外部からでは指導はできても強制ができないのだ。
jp_grezzo: "ログを見るに、他の区画でも暴走している作業機械がいるようなのだが…潜入して彼らにも精密検査を受けさせてくれないだろうか？各区画は独立していて、外部からでは指導はできても強制ができないのだ。"
en: Looking at the logs, it seems that there are some more malfunctioning work machines in the other sectors... Can you infiltrate the affected areas, and have the machines undergo a thorough inspection as well? Each sector is independent, and while we can provide guidance from the outside, we have no control of the inside.
en_grezzo: "Looking at the logs, it seems that there are some more malfunctioning work machines in the other sectors... Can you infiltrate the affected areas, and have the machines undergo a thorough inspection as well? Each sector is independent, and while we can provide guidance from the outside, we have no control of the inside."
it: Dai registri risulta che anche negli altri settori ci sono macchine da lavoro impazzite... Te la sentiresti di infiltrarti e far fare il controllo approfondito anche a loro? Ogni settore è indipendente: da fuori possiamo dare indicazioni, ma non imporle.

jp: そうか…すまない。
jp_grezzo: "そうか…すまない。"
en: I see... Sorry for bothering you.
en_grezzo: "I see... Sorry for bothering you."
it: Capisco... scusami.

jp: なんと頼もしい。貴君に託すぞ！
jp_grezzo: "なんと頼もしい。貴君に託すぞ！"
en: How reassuring. I shall leave it to you!
en_grezzo: "How reassuring. I shall leave it to you!"
it: Che sollievo. Lo affido a te!

jp: しばらく行きたくない…
jp_grezzo: "しばらく行きたくない…"
en: I'm not up to it for now...
en_grezzo: "I'm not up to it for now..."
it: Per un po' non ci voglio andare...

jp: もうちょっとやってみる
jp_grezzo: "もうちょっとやってみる"
en: I'll keep working at it a bit longer.
en_grezzo: "I'll keep working at it a bit longer."
it: Ci provo ancora un po'

jp: 潜入の方は上手くやれそうかね？
jp_grezzo: "潜入の方は上手くやれそうかね？"
en: How's the infiltration coming along?
en_grezzo: "How's the infiltration coming along?"
it: L'infiltrazione, procede bene?

jp: …無理せず休んでくれたまえ。
jp_grezzo: "…無理せず休んでくれたまえ。"
en: ...Take it easy and get some rest.
en_grezzo: "...Take it easy and get some rest."
it: ...Non sforzarti, riposati pure.

jp: 了解した。無理せずじっくり取り組んでもらって構わない。健闘を祈っている。
jp_grezzo: "了解した。無理せずじっくり取り組んでもらって構わない。健闘を祈っている。"
en: Understood. Take your time, and don't overdo things. I wish you luck.
en_grezzo: "Understood. Take your time, and don't overdo things. I wish you luck."
it: Ricevuto. Prenditi tutto il tempo che serve, senza strafare. Ti auguro buona fortuna.

jp: 今忙しいんだ
jp_grezzo: "今忙しいんだ"
en: I'm busy right now.
en_grezzo: "I'm busy right now."
it: Adesso ho da fare

jp: 暇だしやるよ
jp_grezzo: "暇だしやるよ"
en: I have time, so I'll help.
en_grezzo: "I have time, so I'll help."
it: Tempo ne ho, ci penso io

jp: 長期戦になるかもしれないが…やってくれるかね？
jp_grezzo: "長期戦になるかもしれないが…やってくれるかね？"
en: I know it's a long shot, but... will you take the job?
en_grezzo: "I know it's a long shot, but... will you take the job?"
it: Potrebbe essere una faccenda lunga... te ne occupi tu?

jp: そうか。すまない。
jp_grezzo: "そうか。すまない。"
en: I see. My apologies.
en_grezzo: "I see. My apologies."
it: Capisco. Scusami.

jp: 関係者以外は立ち入り禁止なのだが、わが権限で特別にＩＤと転送経路を用意した。怪しまれずに潜入できるだろう。健闘を祈っている！
jp_grezzo: "関係者以外は立ち入り禁止なのだが、わが権限で特別にＩＤと転送経路を用意した。怪しまれずに潜入できるだろう。健闘を祈っている！"
en: The area is restricted to authorized personnel, but I have prepared a special ID and transfer route for you. I'm sure you can sneak in without attracting suspicion. I wish you luck!
en_grezzo: "The area is restricted to authorized personnel, but I have prepared a special ID and transfer route for you. I'm sure you can sneak in without attracting suspicion. I wish you luck!"
it: L'accesso è vietato ai non addetti, ma con la mia autorità ti ho preparato un ID e una via di trasferimento apposta. Potrai infiltrarti senza destare sospetti. Ti auguro buona fortuna!

jp: 興味がない
jp_grezzo: "興味がない"
en: Not interested.
en_grezzo: "Not interested."
it: Non mi interessa

jp: 内容を知りたい
jp_grezzo: "内容を知りたい"
en: Tell me the details.
en_grezzo: "Tell me the details."
it: Voglio sapere di cosa si tratta

jp: よくぞ来てくれた。貴君をわが艦に迎え入れたのは、協力を要請したいことがあるためだ。もちろん報酬は用意しているが、どうかね？
jp_grezzo: "よくぞ来てくれた。貴君をわが艦に迎え入れたのは、協力を要請したいことがあるためだ。もちろん報酬は用意しているが、どうかね？"
en: I'm glad you're here. The reason I've invited you aboard my ship is because I need your help with something. Of course, I've prepared a reward for your services. How about it?
en_grezzo: "I'm glad you're here. The reason I've invited you aboard my ship is because I need your help with something. Of course, I've prepared a reward for your services. How about it?"
it: Hai fatto bene a venire. Ti ho accolto sulla mia nave perché ho una collaborazione da chiederti. Il compenso naturalmente c'è. Che ne dici?

jp: …とある区画で暴走している作業機械がいる。こちらからの指令も一切受け付けない状態だ。送り込んだ者たちは囚われ、1機たりとも帰ってこなかった。艦長である私は持ち場を離れるわけにはいかない…そこで、だ。
jp_grezzo: "…とある区画で暴走している作業機械がいる。こちらからの指令も一切受け付けない状態だ。送り込んだ者たちは囚われ、1機たりとも帰ってこなかった。艦長である私は持ち場を離れるわけにはいかない…そこで、だ。"
en: ...There are some unruly work machines in a particular section of the ship who are refusing to accept any of our orders. The workers we sent to rectify the issue got trapped themselves, and not a single one of them has returned. As captain, I can't leave my post, so...
en_grezzo: "...There are some unruly work machines in a particular section of the ship who are refusing to accept any of our orders. The workers we sent to rectify the issue got trapped themselves, and not a single one of them has returned. As captain, I can't leave my post, so..."
it: ...In un certo settore ci sono macchine da lavoro impazzite. Non accettano più nessun comando da qui. Quelle che abbiamo mandato dentro sono rimaste intrappolate, e non ne è tornata indietro nemmeno una. Io sono il capitano e non posso lasciare il mio posto... ed è qui che entri tu.

jp: 貴君には該当区画に潜入し、作業機械の暴走を止めてもらいたいのだ。その気になったらまた話しかけてくれたまえ。
jp_grezzo: "貴君には該当区画に潜入し、作業機械の暴走を止めてもらいたいのだ。その気になったらまた話しかけてくれたまえ。"
en: I need you to infiltrate the sector in question and put an end to the outbreak of disobedient machines. Please talk to me again when you are ready.
en_grezzo: "I need you to infiltrate the sector in question and put an end to the outbreak of disobedient machines. Please talk to me again when you are ready."
it: Voglio che ti infiltri nel settore in questione e che fermi l'impazzimento delle macchine da lavoro. Quando te la senti, torna a parlarmi.
